title: DoGMA: A Central-Dogma-Guided Foundation Model for Multi-Omics Alignment and Multi-Task Learning in Oncology
abstract: arXiv:2608.08148v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attention mechanisms have been widely utilized in modern deep learning, and many existing multi-omics models inherit their conventional use to allow unrestricted bidirectional interactions. However, the fundamental logic of life is directional. Existing designs often overlook the directionality suggested by the central dogma, potentially limiting transfer across heterogeneous cancers, downstream tasks, and incomplete modality settings. In this work, we present DoGMA, a central-dogma-guided foundation model for pan-cancer multi-omics analysis, arguing that robust transfer requires representations with domain-specific inductive bias. Concretely, we build it on a Transformer-MoE architecture where directed attention biases inter-omics communication toward central-dogma information flow. We further pretrain our model with masked hierarchical omics reconstruction to guide it toward learning central-dogma-consistent interactions. Acr

translated_title: DoGMA：一种以中心法则为导向的肿瘤学多组学对齐与多任务学习基础模型
translated_abstract: 注意力机制在现代深度学习中被广泛使用，许多现有多组学模型沿用了其传统用法，允许无限制的双向交互。然而，生命的基本逻辑是方向性的。现有设计往往忽略了中心法则所提示的方向性，这可能限制了模型在异质性癌症、下游任务以及模态不完整设置之间的迁移能力。在本工作中，我们提出了DoGMA，一个以中心法则为导向的泛癌症多组学分析基础模型，并论证了稳健的迁移需要具备领域特定归纳偏置的表示。具体而言，我们将其构建于Transformer-MoE架构之上，其中有向注意力使组学间通信偏向中心法则的信息流动方向。我们进一步采用掩码分层组学重构对模型进行预训练，引导其学习与中心法则一致的交互。
tldr: 提出了DoGMA，一个以中心法则为导向的泛癌症多组学基础模型，通过在Transformer-MoE架构中引入有向注意力和掩码分层组学重构预训练，将组学间信息流约束为中心法则方向，从而在异质性癌症、下游任务和模态不完整设置之间实现稳健迁移。
en_tdlr: DoGMA is a central-dogma-guided foundation model for pan-cancer multi-omics analysis that constrains inter-omics information flow toward central-dogma directionality via directed attention in a Transformer-MoE architecture and masked hierarchical omics reconstruction pretraining, enabling robust transfer across heterogeneous cancers, downstream tasks, and incomplete modality settings.
